title: Wear - eCarbs start time recorded in hours instead of minutes
body:
Here I am trying to start the eCarbs in 15 minutes.
![photo_2022-06-28_09-00-30](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29897815/176212919-c317be93-e515-4db3-936c-2542d8ebd14c.jpg)

Here it's telling me that it'll start at 11:53PM.
![photo_2022-06-28_09-00-24](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29897815/176212958-8bc6ae77-20d2-42da-9f92-6eea4264b820.jpg)

But it's on 8:53AM at the time, so it should be saying it'll start at 9:08AM.
![photo_2022-06-28_09-00-34](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29897815/176212981-a9a0484b-405c-40df-9bff-035210fcd7d8.jpg)


I am currently on dev-n
![photo_2022-06-28_09-05-33](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29897815/176213971-c712b903-3be9-4944-8a97-38bb9753c15a.jpg)

Don't have any logs because I never committed the transaction.

comments.body:
I suspect that the issue is from DataHandlerMobile.kt

```
 private fun handleECarbsPreCheck(command: EventData.ActionECarbsPreCheck) {
        val startTimeStamp = System.currentTimeMillis() + T.hours(command.carbsTimeShift.toLong()).msecs()
```

Should be

```
 private fun handleECarbsPreCheck(command: EventData.ActionECarbsPreCheck) {
        val startTimeStamp = System.currentTimeMillis() + T.mins(command.carbsTimeShift.toLong()).msecs()
```

AndroidStudio won't let me build right now, the git menu is missing and when I click on the other menus nothing is showing up... so I can't test it right now.

Got AndroidStudio working properly, but I can't build AAPS I'm getting this error:
e: /home/sam/StudioProjects/AndroidAPS-fork/app/src/main/java/info/nightscout/androidaps/plugins/general/nsclient/NSClientFragment.kt: (20, 35): Unresolved reference: NSAndroidClient

I was able to build dev-n with my fix and it is working
